title: children: a hole the parent fills

slides.say: You nest tags inside a div all the time. You can do the same with your own components.
Here Avatar is nested inside Card. So what does Card receive?
Whatever you nest arrives in a prop called children. Card renders it inside its wrapper div.

slides.text: A component with children has a hole any JSX can fill. Great for panels, grids, cards.
slides.say: Think of children as a hole the parent fills with any JSX. It is perfect for visual wrappers like panels and grids.
